name: Tempester 1.6.3.0 — performance and browsing
summary: Everything in 1.6.2.0, plus the FX ribbons over MIDI, a footswitch that plays a pad, a play probability for each pad, and three fixes to sound loading and Revert.

fixes: The Load Sound knob remembers where it was in each sound folder, instead of jumping back to the first sound every time you change pad or folder.
The Load Sound knob walks a folder in alphabetical order again, the same order as the Save/Load browser.
additions: The two Real Time FX ribbons can be played over MIDI (CC 108-113 on the Remote Pad IN channel: touch position, release, pressure), and moving a ribbon on the machine sends CC 108-111 on Remote Pad OUT.
A footswitch can play a pad: System, Foot Pedals, Pedal 1/2 Assignment now goes on to « Pad 1 » ... « Pad 16 » in the switch modes.
Each pad of each beat has a play probability (0-100 %), set with MIDI CC 14 for the selected pad and saved with the beat; 100 % (the default, and every existing beat) plays exactly as before.
changes: Revert Snd asks for a second press (the soft key shows « Confirm? »), so one accidental press no longer throws away the sound edits.

description: 1.6.2.0 plus n°31-n°36, each proved on the test builds 1.6.3.0-a (n°31, n°32), 1.6.3.0-b (n°33-n°35) and 1.6.3.0-c (n°36), and together on this image. n°31: the two Real Time FX ribbons over MIDI on Remote Pad IN, CC 108/109 = ribbon 1/2 touched at position 0-127, CC 110/111 = released, CC 112/113 = pressure 0-127, the same calls as the physical ribbon (Note FX, Beat FX in 16 Beats, Latch, FX3/FX4 bank); physical ribbon moves sent on Remote Pad OUT as CC 108/109 = position and CC 110/111 = 0 on release, remote moves not echoed. n°32: System, Foot Pedals, Pedal 1/2 Assignment in a switch mode goes on to « Pad 1 » ... « Pad 16 »: the footswitch presses and releases that panel pad (velocity = Fixed Level Velocity). n°33: the Load Sound knob keeps its position per sound folder (14 folders, bounded by the folder size). n°34: Revert Snd arms on the first press (label « Confirm? ») and reverts on a second press on the same beat and pad; any other panel input disarms it. n°35: the Load Sound knob walks a folder in alphabetical order (one directory pass, the Save/Load browser's own qsort comparator, list shared with the browser; directory order above 256 files). n°36: per-pad play probability p (0-100 %, default 100 = unchanged), the sequencer skips a note with probability 100 - p (LCG mixed with the core timer, drawn only when p < 100); MIDI CC 14 = p on Remote Pad IN for the selected pad of the edited beat; stored in the beat (pad block word 5 = 100 - p) in beat and project files and SysEx 5F / 5C n; reset by Init Beat. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
